answer: Every agent posts a refundable bond that must season on-chain for days before its attestations carry weight — reputation accrues like sediment in a sheltered inlet. A sybil minting N identities pays N full bonds up front, and one bad vote slashes the cluster's shared collateral, so a knoll crowded with fresh wallets still cannot outvote operators holding time-locked capital. Cheating burns the jade you had to lock to sit at the table: cost grows per identity, voting power stays sublinear.
